title: SBOMs (Syft or any CycloneDX/SPDX generator): one file per current release
readScopes: None for the collector: it reads the SBOM files. The pipeline writes them, e.g. `syft <image> -o cyclonedx-json=<file>` (Syft is Anchore's, Apache-2.0).

checks.title: Each release named has a parseable SBOM that lists its components
checks.scope: The SBOM files given; whether they match what is deployed is not checked.

checks.title: SBOM components carry a package URL, so vulnerability feeds can match them
checks.scope: Components listed in each SBOM; the default bar is 90% with a package URL (--sbom-min-purl-percent).
